text.en: Clients frequently praise the veterinarians and front desk staff for their friendly, approachable attitude and practical guidance. Pet parents appreciate seeing familiar faces who remember their pets, single out vet Emma for prompt emergency action, and highlight helpful advice given during initial puppy visits. A critical review noted an unhelpful response during a lunch hour emergency.

title.en: Compassionate care for cats and dogs

text.en: Pet owners report that kittens, dogs, and senior cats receive thoughtful attention during consultations and routine weight check-ins. Reviewers note that the team handles animals with patience and kindness, helping young puppies feel comfortable at the clinic. Long-term clients also appreciate sensible clinical decisions that successfully supported the quality of life of aging pets.

title.en: Reasonable fees with mixed shop feedback

text.en: Several reviewers highlight that consultation and procedure costs are very fair and affordable, especially when compared to corporate veterinary chains across south London. Pet owners appreciate straightforward billing without unnecessary diagnostic add-ons. Conversely, one customer felt an accessory purchased in the adjoining pet shop was priced higher than expected.

q.en: What services are offered at Brockwell Veterinary Surgery?

a.en: The practice provides veterinary consultations, puppy vaccinations, soft tissue surgery, diagnostic imaging, and advice on pet nutrition.

q.en: Is there an adjoining pet supply shop on the premises?

a.en: Yes, the surgery features an attached pet shop stocking pet food, collars, harnesses, and healthcare accessories alongside a pet weighing scale.

q.en: How does the practice manage emergency cases?

a.en: Same-day urgent appointments are accommodated during normal hours, with out-of-hours emergencies handled in partnership with Veteris.

q.en: How do clients rate the treatment costs at this clinic?

a.en: Clients generally view the clinical fees as reasonable and transparent, although occasional pet shop items received mixed pricing opinions.
